richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Patna

c: Early mornings in Patna belong to the walkers, from Gandhi Maidan to the city's ward parks, the riverfront and the lawns of government colonies. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Patna for the Patna Municipal Corporation, government and PSU colonies, apartment societies, schools, colleges and hospital campuses. Our Fun Fitness machines are made at our factory in Vasai, about 1430 km from the city.

We send each order to Bihar by road, and a dealer in eastern India or our own installation team fixes it on site. Patna's summers are hot and humid, the monsoon is heavy and parts of the city waterlog after a downpour. Winters are cold, with fog on many mornings. Drainage is the first thing we look at in site photos, because a machine standing in water for days is harder to maintain.

items.q: Can a government colony in Patna order an outdoor gym?
items.a: Yes. Government colonies, PSUs, societies and civic bodies can all order from us. Share the area, photos and expected users, approve our layout and quote, and we manufacture and install.

items.q: How do we stop rust after the monsoon?
items.a: The frames are galvanised, which resists corrosion. Keep the footings clear of standing water, wipe the joints after long wet spells and report any damaged coating to our after-sales team.

items.q: Who do I contact for spare parts in Bihar?
items.a: Call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or email aftersales@funplaysystems.com with the machine name and a photo. They arrange the part and the visit.
